key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open Spotlight. Default is Ctrl+Space.

key.name: theme-preference
key.description: Color theme for Spotlight. Values: default (follows system), dark, light.

key.name: clipboard-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open Spotlight in clipboard history mode.

key.name: emoji-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open Spotlight in emoji selector mode.

key.name: recently-used-emojis
key.description: Emojis recently selected by the user.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: Automatically paste after selecting a clipboard history entry or emoji.

key.name: clipboard-paste-button
key.summary: Add button to paste an entry
key.description: If true, adds another button to each menu entry that lets you immediately paste it

key.name: clipboard-pinned-on-bottom
key.summary: Display the pinned section on the bottom
key.description: If true, places the "pinned" section on the bottom

key.name: clipboard-enable-deletion
key.summary: Enable the deletion of clipboard items from your history
key.description: If true, displays 'delete' buttons on each item, and a 'Clear History' option

key.name: clipboard-history-size
key.summary: The number of items to save in history

key.name: clipboard-display-mode
key.summary: What to display in top bar

key.name: clipboard-disable-down-arrow
key.summary: Remove down arrow in top bar

key.name: clipboard-blink-icon-on-copy
key.description: If true, the topbar icon will blink when content is copied to clipboard.

key.name: clipboard-show-clear-history-button
key.description: If true, the clear history button will be displayed.

key.name: clipboard-clear-on-boot
key.summary: Clear clipboard history on every system reboot.

key.name: clipboard-preview-size
key.summary: Amount of visible characters for clipboard items
key.description: The number of characters to display for every clipboard item in the history menu

key.name: clipboard-topbar-preview-size
key.summary: Amount of visible characters in topbar
key.description: The number of characters to display for current clipboard item in the topbar

key.name: clipboard-cache-size
key.summary: The allowed size for the registry cache file in MB
key.description: If the cache overflows this limit, the file will be overriden. High limit might cause slowness of shell startup.

key.name: clipboard-cache-only-favorites
key.summary: Disable the registry cache file for favorites and use memory only
key.description: Contents which are not favorites are not stored and retrieved from a cache (registry.txt) file. This can avoid writing passwords to a plaintext file, but at the cost of persistant history. Your clipboard history, except favorite items, is lost after a gnome-shell session ends or the extension is reloaded.

key.name: clipboard-notify-on-copy
key.summary: Show notification on copy to clipboard
key.description: If true, a notification is shown when content is copied to clipboard.

key.name: clipboard-notify-on-cycle
key.summary: Show notification when cycling through the entries with hotkeys
key.description: If true, a notification is shown when cycling through the clipboard entries using hotkeys.

key.name: clipboard-notify-on-clear
key.description: If true, a notification is shown when the history is cleared.

key.name: clipboard-confirm-clear
key.summary: Show confirmation dialog on Clear History
key.description: If true, a confirmation dialog is shown when attempting to Clear History.

key.name: clipboard-confirm-pinned-delete
key.summary: Show confirmation dialog on deleting pinned item
key.description: If true, a confirmation dialog is shown when attempting to delete a pinned item.

key.name: clipboard-strip-text
key.description: If true, white spaces around text will be removed.

key.name: clipboard-move-item-first
key.summary: Move items to the top of the list when selected.
key.description: If true, move items to the top of the list when it is selected.

key.name: clipboard-keep-selected-on-clear
key.description: Whether to keep the currently selected entry in the clipboard after clearing the history

key.name: clipboard-enable-keybindings
key.description: If true, user can delete and cycle through the history with keyboard shortcuts

key.name: clipboard-prev-entry
key.summary: Key to cycle to the previous entry in the clipboard

key.name: clipboard-next-entry
key.description: Key to cycle to the next entry in the clipboard

key.name: clipboard-toggle-menu
key.description: Key to toggle the clipboard menu

key.name: clipboard-private-mode-binding
key.description: Key to toggle the private mode

key.name: clipboard-cache-images
key.description: Allow caching images to disk

key.name: clipboard-excluded-apps
key.description: A list of applications that are excluded from clipboard history.

key.name: clipboard-clear-history-on-interval
key.description: If true, clipboard history will be cleared at regular intervals.

key.name: clipboard-clear-history-interval
key.summary: Interval for clearing history in minutes
key.description: The interval in minutes at which the clipboard history will be cleared.

key.name: clipboard-next-history-clear
key.description: The timestamp for the next scheduled history clear.

key.name: clipboard-case-sensitive-search
key.description: Make search case sensitive

key.name: clipboard-regex-search
key.description: Allow regex in search

key.name: clipboard-open-at-cursor
key.description: If true, the menu will open at the cursor position when using the keyboard shortcut.

key.name: clipboard-show-delete-button
key.summary: Show the delete button on each item

key.name: clipboard-show-tag-button
key.summary: Show the tag button on each item

key.name: clipboard-show-pin-button
key.summary: Show the pin/favorite button on each item

key.name: clipboard-show-edit-button
key.summary: Show the edit button on each text item

key.name: clipboard-show-preview-button
key.summary: Show the preview button on each image item

key.name: emoji-position
key.description: Possible values can be 'top' or 'bottom'.

key.name: emoji-nbcols
key.description: Sets the number of column of emojis to display.

key.name: emoji-emojisize
key.description: Default size of emojis (px) ; doesn't concern recently used items

key.name: emoji-window-location
key.description: Where to display the emoji window: 'Top bar', 'Cursor'.

key.name: emoji-paste-on-select
key.summary: if paste on select is enabled
key.description: if true, Selecting an emoji will attempt to paste it on the focused textfield

key.name: emoji-keep-open
key.summary: if the menu stays open after selecting an emoji
key.description: if true, the emoji menu will stay open after selecting an emoji, allowing to pick several emojis in a row.

key.name: emoji-active-keybind
key.description: if true, Super+Period will toggle the menu.

key.name: emoji-always-show
key.summary: if icon should always be shown
key.description: if false, Super+Period will be the only way to display the popup menu.

key.name: emoji-skin-tone
key.description: 0 is none, 1 is light, ..., 5 is dark.

key.name: emoji-gender
key.description: 0 is none, 1 is women, 2 is men.

key.name: emoji-emoji-keybind
key.description: Keyboard shortcut which opens the extension's menu.
